full_details.title: ChatGPT Ads Conversion Setup
full_details.full_description:
I need help setting up ChatGPT ads conversion tracking with Google Tag Manager on my Shopify store. The main goal is to optimize my ad spend. 

Key Requirements:
- Track purchases as the primary conversion action.
- Integrate with Google Tag Manager
- Ensure accurate data flow to measure ad effectiveness 

Ideal Skills and Experience:
- Proficient in Google Tag Manager
- Experience with Shopify and e-commerce tracking
- Knowledge of ChatGPT ads and conversion metrics

Please provide a detailed plan and timeline.
